description.value: Burgoo is a cosy comfort-food bistro group with three Vancouver neighbourhoods represented; the Downtown location sits at 1100 Burrard Street and has been part of the city's dining scene since the original Point Grey bistro opened in 2001. The menu leans into hearty, warming dishes — French onion soup, poutine, mac and cheese, and stews — in an old-world countryside atmosphere using earth tones and natural materials. Cyclists will find a full sit-down experience as well as takeout and delivery options, with vegetarian dishes woven throughout the menu.
